svg.title: Measured KPBS 89.5 MHz radio-frequency and FM multiplex spectra
svg.desc: Thirty seconds recorded in University Heights on September 28, 2026. The upper graph shows the central analog FM transmission and HD Radio sidebands. The lower graph shows the demodulated FM multiplex, with reference markers at 19 kHz stereo-pilot reference, 38 kHz suppressed stereo subcarrier, and 57 kHz RDS. Each trace is normalized independently and is not calibrated signal strength.
svg.text: One recorded FM station, several different decoders
KPBS 89.5 MHz · University Heights, San Diego · September 28, 2026, 00:45:39 PDT · 30-second capture
Each panel is normalized to its own peak; levels are relative, not calibrated field strength.
Digital sidebands were confirmed by nrsc5; the central FM signal also carried valid RDS groups.
B Audio-frequency multiplex after FM demodulation
*19 and 38 kHz mark standard stereo locations; no clear 19 kHz pilot is visible in this recording.
Stereo difference audio uses a suppressed 38 kHz carrier. The additional ~67 kHz subcarrier was not identified.
Hann-window power averages over 30 s; display bins: 200 Hz (RF), 50 Hz (multiplex). No de-emphasis applied.
